purpose: Connect a contrast or gently leave a thought open.
keywords: I want to go, but I am busy today.
There is something I would like to ask.
restrictions: A trailing けど may invite a response rather than state an explicit contrast.
mistake: Nouns and な-adjectives use だけど in plain clauses.
